The test image shows a mango leaf with distinct dark brown/black irregular necrotic spots scattered across the leaf surface. The spots have defined edges and appear as discrete lesions on an otherwise green leaf. No white powder, no sooty coating, no tip dieback.

Now let me view one reference image — Anthracnose, as these discrete dark lesions are most consistent with that disease.

The reference Anthracnose image shows a severely wilted/browned leaf (advanced stage). The test image shows an earlier stage with discrete dark brown necrotic spots on a still-green leaf — classic Anthracnose lesion pattern. Die Back causes tip/shoot death, Powdery Mildew causes white powder, Sooty Mould causes black sooty coating. None of those match the test image's pattern of discrete dark spots on a green leaf.
